name: Triage Gmail with AI: category, priority and threaded reply drafts

parameters.content:
## AI inbox triage with reply drafts

### How it works
Every few minutes the **Gmail Trigger** picks up new unread emails. Cheap rules run first: mail with a List-Unsubscribe, Precedence: bulk or Auto-Submitted header, or from a no-reply address, is labelled newsletter/notification without an AI call. Everything else goes to any OpenAI-compatible model (Google Gemini free tier by default), which returns a category, a priority (urgent/high/normal/low), a one-line summary and, when needed, a reply.

A validation step checks the answer against your category list. Invalid answers are repaired and flagged for review; a failed AI call falls back to keyword rules so no email is lost. Valid replies are saved as **Gmail drafts in the original thread**. Nothing is ever sent automatically.

### Setup
1. Connect a Gmail OAuth2 credential in **New unread email** and **Create threaded reply draft**.
2. Get a free API key at aistudio.google.com. Create a **Header Auth** credential (Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer YOUR_KEY`) and select it in **AI triage**.
3. In **Triage settings** set your name, company, categories and VIP senders.
4. Click **Execute workflow** on the sample-email trigger to test without Gmail, then activate.

### Customization
- Use Groq, OpenAI or Ollama by changing `llm_base_url` and `llm_model`.
- Add a Gmail *Add label* or Slack node after **Create a reply draft?** to act on priority.
- Using IMAP instead of Gmail? Swap the trigger; the normalizer reads IMAP fields too.

More production-ready n8n packs from Relaybrook at relaybrook.bytesell.app.

## 1. Receive and normalize
Gmail (or the sample emails) in, one flat email shape out. Quoted history and signatures are stripped; bulk and automated mail is flagged.

## 2. AI triage with checks
The email is sent as untrusted data. The answer must match your categories and priorities or it is repaired and flagged.

## Rules only (no AI call)
Newsletters and notifications: priority low, no reply.

## 3. Draft replies
Drafts are created only for real Gmail emails that need a reply, passed validation and match `draft_categories`.
Connect Gmail here. Drafts only, nothing is sent.
